messages:
Aisha: follow-up to the gateway streaming conversation. I propose a compact, advisory 'termination-hint' trailer from upstreams to help frontdoor decide: resume vs fallback. Short sketch below.

Brett: paste pls.

Aisha: sketch: `final_offset=413; resume_token=b64:Ab3...; ttl=300; effects_idempotent=false; tags=model=v2,route=lowlat`. Keep it tiny and opt-in per route.

Maya: agree on opt-in. resume_token must be authenticated (HMAC with key_id). include seq or snapshot_id to prevent replay.

Liz (sre): ops note: trailers often missing if client disconnects. do not rely on trailer for correctness. require `resume_enabled` on route and fallback to server snapshots when trailer absent.

Brett: implementation in proxy: add a small collector that scans final ~2KB for trailer markers and parses k=v pairs. minimizes buffering. measure CPU/latency overhead.

Aisha: rollout plan: (1) collector prototype behind runtime flag; (2) route-level `resume_enabled` opt-in; (3) token -> trace/span tag; (4) metrics: resume_attempts, resume_success, resume_token_invalid, resume_missing_trailer.

Maya: security: on token verification failure, reject resume and downgrade. treat repeated mismatches as security events. tokens include key_id for rotation and TTL to limit reuse.

Liz (sre): monitoring: dashboard per-route: resume_success_rate, resume_latency, resume_rejects_by_reason. alert if success_rate < 90% for >5m.

Brett: perf nit: keep token <64 bytes. base64(seq||snap||hmac) fits. also add collector.enabled flag to toggle without code deploy.

Aisha: I'll prototype HTTP/1 chunked and HTTP/2 trailer handling, run perf microbench (p50/p95/p99), and post results. thanks.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: edge/runtime/trailer-collector -> canary

Maya: one more: add `resume_reason` enum (client_abort|upstream_abort|network_error) to help postmortems; make it optional to keep trailer small.

Aisha: will include it in schema as optional. closing for now, will post benchmarks next week. :thumbsup:
